children: Alignment Healthcare reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.36B, up 36.7% from $993.7M a year earlier, as membership growth was offset by higher medical costs. The company posted a net loss of $8.1M, compared with net income of $3.7M in the prior-year quarter, and diluted EPS was $(0.04) versus $0.02.
Revenue was $1.36B, compared with $993.7M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 36.7%.
Net loss attributable to Alignment Healthcare was $8.1M, compared with net income of $3.7M in the prior-year quarter.
Diluted EPS was $(0.04), compared with $0.02 in the prior-year quarter.
Health plan membership rose 31.2% year over year to 301,200, supporting revenue growth.
For 2026, plans span 45 markets across five states. Since 2020, the company has entered 29 markets and four states.
California’s H3815 contract, covering about 75% of members, received 3.5 stars for 2027; six other eligible plans retained ratings of 4 stars or higher.
The company said its AVA analytics platform and Care Anywhere teams support personalized care, and management cited improved outcomes and lower costs for returning members.
Investment priorities include technology, market expansion, sales and marketing, and supplemental benefits.
